first_principles_findings.finding: The only independently identifiable wide response payload in M935 is exactly two registered 1152-bit slots, or 288 bytes. Subtracting this lower bound from the frozen 16384-byte FIFO/control reserve leaves 16096 bytes without a sealed field inventory, depth, width, port, concurrency, clock/reset, lifetime, owner or live-consumer mapping.
first_principles_findings.consequence: Instantiating the residual would either create dummy capacity or invent architecture; neither is an honest physicalization of the frozen ledger.

first_principles_findings.finding: The five non-FIFO metadata proxies are ledger capacities, not proven one-to-one live physical objects. Their owner, simultaneous-access and lifetime graph remains absent, and 1152/2304-byte proxy values do not directly define whole 2048-byte foundry macros.
first_principles_findings.consequence: Macro count, standard-cell state or identical external common charge cannot be assigned without evidence, overlap or coordinate change.

minimum_legal_next_semantic_mapping_sour.artifact_class: source-only semantic mapping; no RTL, wrapper, filelist, Tcl or EDA
required_fields_per_row: logical object and field inventory with evidence path
mapping class restricted to foundry macro, implemented standard-cell state or identical external common charge
minimum_legal_next_semantic_mapping_sour.fifo_specific_gate: Account for the existing 288-byte M935 payload and evidence every bit assigned to the remaining 16096-byte reserve; unexplained padding is not live storage and cannot close the row.
minimum_legal_next_semantic_mapping_sour.global_conservation_gate: The six rows must sum to exactly 24448 bytes and combine with 190464 known bytes to exactly 214912 bytes, with no dummy capacity, overlap or silent coordinate change.
